title: SR SmartChest
description: A lightweight and efficient smart chest management utility for Minecraft servers.
body:

SR_SmartChest is a lightweight plugin designed to help players manage their chests with greater convenience and speed. Developed with a focus on performance and ease of use, it is suitable for any server type, including Survival, Skyblock, or Community-based environments.  
How to Use
Enable the Feature: Use the command /smartchest on to activate the system.  
Categorize Your Items: Place one sample item that you wish to categorize into the chest and close it.  
Automatic Sorting: Once set, the chest will automatically "suck" or pull that specific item type from your inventory.  
Proximity Collection: By simply standing near your categorized chest, it will automatically pull the designated items from your inventory into the chest.  
Features
Lightweight Performance: Built to ensure a smooth experience without taxing server resources.  
Advanced Configuration: Additional settings and fine-tuning are available within the config.yml file.  
Smart Interaction: Uses a dedicated listener system to handle player and chest interactions seamlessly.
